_meta.purpose: The pre-registration register. Every strategy rule in this workspace is written here BEFORE it is evaluated. The registration is the text plus the window plus the gates; the git commit that adds a row is the binding record.
policy: A rule may not be edited after its evaluation window opens. Corrections are new rows with a new ID and an explicit supersedes link.
Backtest numbers may never be published on the leaderboard. The leaderboard is prospective only. Backtest results live on the backtest page and are labelled as such.
Every entry carries a two-sided 'what would change our mind' field: the evidence that would promote AND the evidence that would demote.
The registration commit hash is recorded for each row. If the hash is missing, the row is not pre-registered and cannot qualify.

registrations.name: Team-strength shadow baseline (singles only)
registrations.rule: For every scheduled game, generate a fair home margin from a ridge-regularised least-squares rating of points-for and points-against, fitted on all settled games in the corpus with a recency half-life of 8 weeks. Publish the fair margin, and the fair spread = -fair_home_margin rounded to the nearest 0.5. Stake nothing. This strategy exists only to produce a probability record before kickoff.
inputs: settled game scores in the corpus
registrations.sample_window: 2026 weeks 1-10 settled games (136 in the frozen corpus, 145 after the official week-10 re-read)
registrations.evaluation: walk-forward: for week w, fit only on weeks < w
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound above 0 on an out-of-sample sample of at least 300 games, holding after multiplicity adjustment.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: A game-cluster lower bound below 0 at any pre-registered checkpoint, or a calibration slope outside [0.8, 1.25] on at least 100 out-of-sample games.
registrations.commit_sha: PENDING - filled by engine/preregister.py at build time

registrations.name: Total: same ratings, independent total estimator
registrations.rule: Estimate each club's scoring rate and conceding rate; fair total = away_rate + home_rate, shrunk toward the league mean by 0.25. Published as a second, independent total estimator and kept visible ALONGSIDE PR-03 (never collapsed) until a walk-forward comparison separates them.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Lower out-of-sample total MAE than PR-03 on a paired test with p < 0.05 on at least 150 games.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Paired test favours PR-03, or either estimator's residual shows a season-long bias larger than 1 point.

registrations.name: Total: league-mean-plus-ratings blend (the competing estimator)
registrations.rule: Fair total = league mean total + (home offence - league) + (home defence conceded - league) + (away offence - league) + (away defence conceded - league). This is deliberately a different functional form from PR-02 so the walk-forward comparison is a real test and not two names for one number.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Lower out-of-sample total MAE than PR-02 on a paired test with p < 0.05 on at least 150 games.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Paired test favours PR-02. In either case BOTH stay published until the sample clears the gate.

registrations.name: Moneyline: ordinal-only logistic on the same strength signal
registrations.rule: Convert the PR-01 fair margin to a win probability with a logistic link whose scale is fitted on walk-forward history only. Origination order is enforced: side first, then total, then moneyline. The moneyline is never originated from a price.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: Brier skill above the base-rate benchmark with a cluster lower bound above 0 on 300+ out-of-sample games.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: Calibration intercept significantly non-zero, meaning the link scale is wrong.

registrations.name: Personnel ablation (injury/depth on vs off)
registrations.rule: Fit the IDENTICAL model twice: once with availability features, once without. Report the difference in out-of-sample error with a paired bootstrap interval. No fixed point penalty for a missing starter is ever applied.
registrations.sample_window: the window where a verified availability feed exists
registrations.blocked_because: no verified, archived availability feed with enough coverage exists in this repo; see the availability page. Registered NOW so that when the feed exists the test cannot be chosen after seeing it.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: A paired difference interval that excludes zero, in the direction that availability features improve out-of-sample error.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: An interval containing zero, which would mean availability is priced in or too noisy to use, and the feature set should be dropped rather than tuned.

registrations.name: Parlay / prop-combo joint-evidence gate
registrations.rule: A multi-leg ticket may ONLY be ranked when (a) a directly validated joint probability exists for that specific combination, or (b) per-leg dependence is estimated from officially sourced numbers with n published, and (c) the operator's void/push rules are recorded. Multiplying marginal probabilities is prohibited. Until then every parlay row is published as BLOCKED, not as a low-ranked pick.
registrations.blocked_because: no official price source exists for legs, and no dependence estimate reaches the n floor
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_up: A dependence estimate with n >= 100 on officially sourced legs whose interval excludes independence, plus recorded void/push rules.
registrations.what_would_change_our_mind_down: An interval that includes independence, in which case the product of marginals is still not published, because including zero is not evidence of zero.
